sol_construction_plan.purpose: one ConstructionPlan root per project; separates current duration, pending change and plan recalculation impact
sol_construction_plan.crossContextReference: project_id has no database foreign key to PROJ
sol_construction_plan.currentPolicy: current_duration_revision_id is the only current effective duration truth
sol_construction_plan.pendingPolicy: pending_change_id is the only current pending change truth
sol_construction_plan.pointerPolicy: pointer columns are physically nullable to avoid a MySQL insert cycle; initialCreate must set current_duration_revision_id and plan_recalculation_source_revision_id before commit, and all non-deleted committed plans must satisfy the post-transaction invariants
sol_construction_plan.fsol001WritePolicy: writes PENDING_RECALCULATION only; other outcomes require a real PLN-01 producer

sol_construction_plan_revision.purpose: duration baseline revision; draft candidate may change until submit and is immutable after submit
sol_construction_plan_revision.immutability: duration fields cannot change after frozen_at is set

sol_construction_plan_change.purpose: duration change request, approval lifecycle and frozen evidence
sol_construction_plan_change.evidencePolicy: store FileArtifact id and exact version only; never URL or file body
sol_construction_plan_change.approvalPolicy: current primary service manager, not applicant; subject fact comes from PROJ public read-only API

stateAxes.forbidden: one overloaded status field for approval, current-effectiveness and recalculation

postTransactionInvariants: every non-deleted sol_construction_plan has a non-null current_duration_revision_id that resolves to a revision of the same tenant and plan
every non-deleted sol_construction_plan has a non-null plan_recalculation_source_revision_id that resolves to a revision of the same tenant and plan
pending_change_id is null or resolves to the same tenant and plan with status PENDING_APPROVAL
current_duration_revision_id is the only current effective duration marker; revision rows do not carry a second current flag

transactions.submit: LOCK_PLAN; VALIDATE_BASE_CURRENT_AND_NO_PENDING; FREEZE_REVISION_AND_EVIDENCE; SET_CHANGE_PENDING_AND_PENDING_POINTER; IDEMPOTENCY_SUCCESS; AUDIT
transactions.approve: LOCK_PLAN_AND_PENDING_CHANGE; REVALIDATE_SCOPE_ROLE_NOT_APPLICANT_AND_FILE_VERSION; SET_CHANGE_APPROVED; SWITCH_CURRENT_POINTER; CLEAR_PENDING; SET_PENDING_RECALCULATION; IDEMPOTENCY_SUCCESS; AUDIT
transactions.rejectOrWithdraw: LOCK_PLAN_AND_PENDING_CHANGE; VALIDATE_SUBJECT_STATE_VERSION; SET_TERMINAL_CHANGE_STATUS; CLEAR_PENDING; KEEP_CURRENT_AND_RECALCULATION_IMPACT; IDEMPOTENCY_SUCCESS; AUDIT

configuration.submitPolicy: reload dictionary and config; invalid or missing config fails closed; freeze resolved boolean on change

projectLookup.emptyPolicy: empty business result, not another project's plan

projectParticipantFact.unknownPolicy: missing, cross-tenant, inconsistent or unknown facts fail closed

permissions.frontendBackendTruth: same permission codes; server revalidates tenant, function, project scope, current participant fact, change state and version

platformFacts.reason: Phase 2 locks PRE-01 to SOL internal synchronous contract and event N/A

legacy.policy: audit for reusable validation and transition logic only; no current truth, no dual write, no automatic migration
forbiddenReuse: directly update project phase plan dates
treat an applied backward calculation as current PRE-01 duration
accept applicant or approver ids from request
store file URLs as evidence truth
infer approval from legacy numeric status
